# flight level

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:axisFlightLevel`](gmeow-axisFlightLevel.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/axisFlightLevel>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

The pressure-altitude axis expressed as ICAO flight level (standard atmosphere 1013.25 hPa). Independent of local QNH; used for en-route airspace bounds.
